findings.text: The docs model card is a product page (specs and lifecycle), not a safety or evaluation report.

source.quote: Our first SOTA enterprise grade model.

findings.text: The model is retired; the page directs new integrations to Mistral Medium 3.5 with retirement date 6/16/2025.

source.quote: This model is retired. Use Mistral Medium 3.5 for new integrations.

findings.text: The listed API name is mistral-medium-2312.

notes: Source is the Mistral Docs model page (https://docs.mistral.ai/models/model-cards/mistral-medium-1-0-23-12, redirects to /models/mistral-medium-1-0-23-12). It is a product/lifecycle page (header date, context 32k, Premier/Retired badges, API id, retirement), not a safety system card: no risk tiers, no safety topics, no numeric eval tables. Modalities appear only as icons with the label Modalities and no plain-text modality names, so modalities is not_stated. Header date December 11, 2023 is treated as releaseDate (page does not say 'released' in words). Blog link https://mistral.ai/news/la-plateforme is on the page but was not used; seed-lookup listed only this document for the card. No pageCount (web page). alsoDocuments empty per seed-lookup.
